title: Заморозить trust boundaries, data flows и threat/misuse model
summary: Выпустить versioned threat contract, который явно разделяет trusted, partially trusted и untrusted inputs, показывает security/durability data flows и связывает misuse cases с owning phases P2–P10.
why: Подтверждённые F01–F05 возникают на границах, где application caller сейчас поставляет security context, clock, authorizer, descriptor и process-local stores; без единой trust model каждая owning phase может локально «починить» неверную границу. `RAG:—` (`@plan/knowledge/findings-audit-verdicts.json`, PHP/Dart ports and confirmation implementations).

include: Assets and security objectives; actors; trust zones; data-flow diagrams for descriptor/arguments/proposal/token/approval/commit, idempotency acquire/effect/complete and event append/load; attacker and accidental-integrator capabilities; abuse/misuse cases; tenant/cross-process/restart/replay/crash boundaries; mitigation owner and required negative evidence per threat; residual/out-of-scope risks.
exclude: Choosing exact P2 service API, P3 token format/crypto, P4 lease schema, P5 event DDL, release security policy or claiming a mitigation already exists.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Each threat has stable `TM-###`, asset, entry point, prerequisite, impact, current disposition, owning PLAN1 phase/item class and proof type. `mitigated` is forbidden without current executable evidence; present gaps are `open`. Application integration code and tool/policy adapters are partially trusted, not silently promoted to trusted. Trusted dependencies are named by role and compromise assumptions. Map F01–F12 exactly once; F13/F14 remain bookkeeping/design-evidence risks, not security threats unless a concrete impact is demonstrated.
guidance: Use compact Mermaid data-flow diagrams plus tables; diagrams do not replace textual trust transitions. Include misuse resistance for caller-supplied time, actor, authorizer, descriptor digest, dual-control choice, replay store and in-memory production presets. Include multi-tenant, multi-process, restart, stale-worker and malicious-persisted-payload cases. Do not copy audit API/DDL sketches as decided mitigations.
deliverables: `threat-model-v1.md` with assets, trust boundaries, data flows, threat/misuse catalog, owner mapping, proof expectations and residual-risk register.

result.notes:
Published @plan/knowledge/root-contracts-threat-model-v1.json (TM-001–TM-014, F01–F12 owners, trust zones/data flows); tools/validate_threat_model_v1.py GREEN.
